en.text: Hi, I'm Emanuel Borges, a Senior Full Stack Developer based in Manaus, Brazil, working fully remote.
I have more than ten years of experience building systems with Java, Kotlin, Node.js, React and React Native, on large-scale projects at INDT, ICCT and Manaus City Hall.
Today my focus is Artificial Intelligence: RAG, semantic search and NLP, backed by postgraduate specializations in Machine Learning Engineering and Natural Language Processing.
The assistant that answers your questions on this portfolio was built by me, in eight languages and at zero cost.
I'm open to new opportunities, so let's talk.
